description: 8-scenario reduced subset of dataset.json for hardware-constrained machines (e.g. 2GB VRAM mobile GPUs like the Quadro M620). Restricted to Town01/Town02 and lower vehicle counts to keep CARLA's render load manageable. Use this for a first end-to-end pass before attempting the full 20-scenario dataset.json.

scenarios.prompt: A pedestrian suddenly crosses near a quiet junction in rainy weather.
Sudden lane change to avoid a parked vehicle on a clear day.
A parked vehicle obstructs the lane on a cloudy day, forcing a small detour.
A vehicle runs a red light at a quiet signalized intersection in clear daylight.
A cyclist crosses an intersection just as the light changes, in clear weather.
A pedestrian darts between two parked cars into a quiet road in clear daylight.
A vehicle blocks a small intersection after running a red light on a cloudy day.
A stalled vehicle obstructs a junction approach during light rain.
